name: postdiff-root
description: Postdiff monorepo — engine in packages/core, terminal surface (CLI + TUI) in apps/terminal. Web/VSCode land later as private apps and never touch the published tarball.

scripts.clean: node -e "for (const d of ['packages/core/dist','apps/terminal/dist','dist']) { try { require('fs').rmSync(d, {recursive:true,force:true}); console.log('removed', d) } catch {} }"
